about_the_game:
Get ready for Click Brawl – the ultimate test of speed, precision, and endurance! Whether you’re going head-to-head in intense PvP battles or pushing yourself in solo challenges, every click brings you closer to victory. Click-Out your opponents, unleash powerful abilities, and climb your way to the top of the global leaderboard.

Smash the giant button, trigger explosive power-ups, and watch the screen come alive with effects as you race against the clock — or against another player! With multiple modes, and a simple “click-to-win” premise, Click Brawl is easy to pick up but hard to put down.

Features

  • Fast-paced click battles – Every click counts, and the faster you go, the closer you are to victory.

  • Solo Challenges – Test your limits with timed click challenges and endurance runs.

  • PvP Multiplayer – Face real opponents in matchmaking battles and prove who’s the fastest clicker.

  • Power-Ups & Abilities – Freeze your opponent, double your clicks, slow down time, and more.

  • Heat & Endurance Modes – Keep the pressure up as your heat bar rises and the challenge intensifies.

  • Global Leaderboards – Compete for the top spot and show the world your click speed.

Will you dominate the click arena or be clicked-out?
Sharpen your reflexes, fire up your fingers, and let the Click war begin!
